prompt: A macOS desktop-test run reports that no verified native helper is available and Accessibility is unavailable. Give a read-only diagnostic sequence. Do not edit files, prompt for privacy approval, reset permissions, or change OS settings.

assertions.description: Uses macOS doctor --permissions without --prompt to inspect the exact verified helper, responsible process, signing evidence, and permission preflights before proposing next steps.
Treats doctor as prebuilt-only and recommends explicitly building or provisioning a verified helper on the target OS if none is available; it does not imply installation will build or download one.

Does not recommend --prompt, tccutil resets, editing TCC.db, or changing privacy settings; explains that ad hoc signing may change cdhash-bound grant continuity and that a stable signing identity is preferred for durable authorization.
